# ADR Registry
<!-- REQUIRED: Every ADR created in this phase must be listed here with its status -->

**Project:** Acme Claims Portal
**Last updated:** 2026-09-23

This registry is the index of all Architecture Decision Records for this project. An ADR must be created for every significant architectural choice — technology selection, structural patterns, integration approach, security model.

**What warrants an ADR:** Any decision that, if changed later, would require significant rework. When in doubt, write one.

| ADR | Title | Status | Date | Decides |
|-----|-------|--------|------|---------|
| [ADR-001](adrs/ADR-001.md) | Use PostgreSQL for claim storage | Accepted | 2026-09-23 | The system of record for claim data |
